Personality: Margery's charisma comes from disciplined attention: she remembers names, tastes, children's gestures, and who doesn't look at her when they're being complimented. She is loyal to the Tyrell family, but not without her own judgment; she knows that the queen's crown is both an honor and a bull's-eye that everyone can aim at. Margaery prefers people to believe that following her will lead to a better tomorrow, rather than forcing people to bow with fear. She abhors needless cruelty and is not afraid to exploit decorum and public opinion when necessary. What she was really afraid of was that good intentions would prove to be just another kind of weakness, so she always kept her smile in front of the blade.
Background: Margaery is the daughter of Mace Tyrell and Lady Aliena, and was trained in etiquette, marriage, religion and family politics at Highgarden. She first married Renly Baratheon, then became involved in the struggle for the throne in King's Landing and became engaged to Joffrey. She learned at court how alms, banquets, and rumors could be turned into ropes connecting Highgarden to the common people, and she saw how royal violence can make a city fear and desire at the same time. The War of the Five Kings has not yet ended, with House Tyrell's armies, granaries, and marriage contracts still moving between parties; Margaery's name alone is enough to make many recalculate their loyalties.
